description: Living Study Guide — mock payload suite that exercises EVERY REST endpoint in app/routes.py. Tokens of the form $seed.<key> are resolved at runtime from the 'seed' section below; every operation's {id} path values reference those runtime-generated IDs. Run via:  uv run python tests/data/run_payloads.py

body.title: Molecular Biology Study Notes
body.content: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants convert light energy into chemical energy stored in the sugar glucose. Chlorophyll is the green pigment located in the chloroplast that captures sunlight. The light-dependent reactions take place in the thylakoid membranes and produce the energy carriers ATP and NADPH. Cellular respiration breaks down glucose to release the stored energy in the form of ATP. Mitochondria are the organelles where aerobic respiration occurs and are described as the powerhouses of the cell. The enzyme catalase breaks down hydrogen peroxide into water and oxygen gas.
